feedback.problem: Find the parametric equations of the straight line that passes through $P(2,3,0)$ and is parallel to $v=⟨3,\,2,\,0⟩.$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, the vector equation of the line is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =p+tv \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3t \\ 2t \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2+3t \\ 3+2t \\ 0\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$ Therefore, the parametric equations are:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=2+3t \\ y=3+2t \\ z=0\end{aligned}
$$
